research_artifacts_reviewed: source registry and final scope notes in output

source_spotchecks.finding: Ibn Zayd water-submersion analogy is present; CQ-002 and NOV-010 preserve this antecedent without asserting that the verse depicts a literal stream.
Author-qualified absence of known Makki disagreement and immediately reported Thalabi Madani attribution support SRC-007, rather than a claim of universal consensus.
Hibatullah split-revelation report does not explicitly assign verses 1–3/4–7; REV-001 retains this restriction.
Qurra ibn Damus raised stone/iron/water report has explicit gharīb/munkar and unknown-chain criticism; source disagreements are retained.
Care for widows/poor comparison and narrator uncertainty about the fasting/prayer comparison match HAD-011.
Ibn Buhayna report of forgotten sitting and prostrations before taslim supports HAD-003; ordinary prayer forgetfulness is distinguished from the S107 warning.
Supplication for the donating family of Ibn Abi Awfa supports HAD-009 and the donor context of 9:103.

source_spotchecks.finding: Primary pages independently checked during the preceding S107 variant reviews: named Hasan (Albani) companion loan report, distinct weak (Darussalam) water/salt/fire report and surplus-water qualification agree with this output.

editorial_findings: All 104 added annotation prose records, 23 novelty records, 36 registry entries and final scope notes were read; all 44 base paragraphs have local claim coverage.
Chronology, historical actors, reported readings and disputed reports retain limits; behaviors are not converted into automatic individual faith judgements.
Split root origins, disputed water derivations and anomalous dictionary branches constrain project images instead of making them mandatory verse meanings.
Prayer in 9:103 concerns donors; QIR-003 explicitly records the base quotation plural versus the Hafs singular, and bounds Tabari reading attributions.
The full Raghib salat entry was not inspected in this variant; its older prayer/fire interpretation found in Astra/high is an additional classical antecedent outside this research scope.
Some Tehzib/Cemhere first-source collations remain openly not_checked. Strong audit coverage does not imply completion of every lexical or isnad investigation.
review_limit: Independent preservation/schema checks, reading of all added prose and novelty records, research coverage review and targeted primary-source spotchecks. Does not certify exhaustive classical literature, printed-text collation or independent isnad research.
